recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13903; any future performedActivity wording change should be handled separately if a later issue such as FHIR-54918 reaches a final workflow state.
issue_request: FHIR-13903 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, asking CarePlan to support tracking past activities or past interventions by updating CarePlan.activity to say it identifies an action that has occurred or is planned.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by df4a77edaa94a67ae85b9796089ed309a304e6a0, which changed the legacy CarePlan spreadsheet short and definition to the requested wording and added the GF#13903 committee note. The 2021 source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 moved CarePlan into source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml while preserving the applied wording.
additional_context: CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini. Later CarePlan activity issues FHIR-26064, FHIR-45000, and FHIR-48415 refined the activity model by renaming outcome/reference/detail to performedActivity/plannedActivityReference/plannedActivityDetail and clarifying performedActivity; these changes are compatible with FHIR-13903. FHIR-54918 is Submitted and is not a final conflicting decision. Zulip and Confluence searches found only tracker/backlog/minutes mentions and no conflicting final community decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml already contains the GF#13903 note, the requested CarePlan.activity short and definition, and performedActivity support/examples for activities that have occurred.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 change renamed CarePlan.activity outcome/reference/detail elements, including performedActivity, without reversing FHIR-13903's allowance for occurred activities.
Applied change refined CarePlan.activity.performedActivity short text and value set while keeping completed or in-progress activities explicit.
Applied change clarified performedActivity and did not add a separate CarePlan.activity.status.
Submitted R6 request about performedActivity short text is not a final decision and was not decided here.
